text: 'Unable to find a valid iOS Simulator runtime' on a MAUI build is almost always Xcode 15+ unbundling simulator runtimes plus Xcode 26 not migrating the previous one. MAUI reads SupportedOSPlatformVersion, asks xcrun simctl for a matching runtime, gets nothing, and bails. Fix on CI: xcodebuild -downloadPlatform iOS -buildVersion 18.2, then verify with xcrun simctl list runtimes.
